{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check the structure
print(df.dtypes)
print(df.head())

# Check for sentinel values in customer_age
print(f"Number of -1 in customer_age: {(df['customer_age'] == -1).sum()}")

# Check revenue column
print(f"Unique revenue values (first 10): {df['revenue'].unique()[:10]}")

# Check for refunded orders
print(f"Number of refunded orders: {(df['status'] == 'refunded').sum()}")

# Check for QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
print(f"Number of QA orders (revenue = 999999.99): {(df['revenue'] == '999999.99').sum()}")"}
